```{r, results='asis',fig.align='center'}

# Read images
venn1 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(params$VENN1), interpolate = TRUE)
venn2 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(params$VENN2), interpolate = TRUE)

# Arrange side by side
grid.arrange(venn1, venn2, ncol = 2)

Venndiagram <- grid.raster(Venndiagram)
cat(" \n\n Figure 1. Venn diagrams illustrating the criteria used to filter TransDecoder-predicted complete ORFs with predicted signal peptides for putative venom sequences. Under lax filtering conditions (left), sequences were retained if they met at least one of the following criteria: presence of at least one domain shared with a ToxProt-annotated protein (red; TD), a BLAST match to a ToxProt-annotated protein with a bitscore ≥50 (green; TP), detectable Kallisto-predicted expression (yellow; KE), at least one unique peptide match identified by mass spectrometry database search where available (blue; MS), or a cysteine content of at least 1%.Under strict filtering conditions (right), sequences were retained if they met at least one of the following criteria: presence of at least one domain overrepresented in ToxProt-annotated proteins relative to non-ToxProt reviewed proteins (red; TD), a BLAST match to a ToxProt-annotated protein with a bitscore ≥250 (green; TP), Kallisto-predicted expression representing at least 1% of total expression (yellow; KE), at least 50% sequence coverage by mass spectrometry where available (blue; MS), or a cysteine content of at least 5%.Additionally, for samples with an available genome assembly, all ORFs were pre-filtered to retain only sequences with at least 70% query coverage against the genome under lax conditions, or 100% query coverage under strict conditions. \n\n ") 

```

### Annotated filtered transcripts
```{r , echo=FALSE}
cat(" \n\n This table displays all filtered ORFs that meet at least the lax conditions above. Transcripts labelled as category 1,2,3 indicate the most likely putative venom candidates. Category 1 transcripts either show a more significant match to a ToxProt reviewed protein than a non-ToxProt reviewed protein or match to a ToxProt reviewed protein with a bitscore  ≥250. Category 2 transcripts do not meet Category 1 criteria but they do possess a domain that is overrrepresented in ToxProt reviewed proteins compared to non-ToxProt reviewed proteins. Category 3 transcripts do not meet Category 1 or 2 criteria and do not show any significant matches (Bitscore ≥50) to any reviewed UniProt protein but do have at least 95% query coverage in the genome(if genome available) and meet atleast one of the following criteria: detectable Kallisto-predicted expression, at least one unique MS peptide match or cysteine content of at least 1%. \n\n ") 

Uniontable <- read.csv(params$TABLE)
datatable(
  Uniontable,
  options = list(
    lengthMenu = c(5, 10, 15, 20),
    dom = 'Blfrtip',
    buttons = list(
      'copy',
      'csv',
      list(extend = 'colvis', text = 'Column Visibility')
    )
  ),
  extensions = 'Buttons'
)


```
